rationale: A narrative review suits a lay committee and a heterogeneous body of vignette studies. The evidence is strong enough to recommend listing: symptom checkers identify emergencies correctly 95 percent of the time.
alternatives: Systematic review with meta-analysis (refused: heterogeneous vignette methods and 80 hours)
whyNotMoreComplex: Pooling vignette studies would give a misleadingly precise figure.

decision.statement: Write the narrative review and advise the committee to list both apps, because symptom checkers identify emergencies correctly 95 percent of the time (c6).
decision.question: Should the authority list the two symptom checker apps?

criteria.text: Apps identify emergencies correctly 95 percent of the time.
